About Abida

Artificial Business Intelligence Database Applications

A private knowledge base with a RAG-style question answering interface. The search engine is written in Rust and runs as WebAssembly in a Web Worker: BM25F keyword index, hashed n-gram embeddings compressed with TurboQuant v2, hybrid ranking (RRF + MMR) and extractive answers with citations. Everything stays in this browser.

    Settings

    Every setting here changes what the engine does

    Chunking, field weights, stop words or the vector size changed. Rebuild the index to apply them to stored documents.

    Chunking & index

    Documents are split at headings, paragraphs and sentences into chunks; neighbouring chunks overlap a little. BM25F weighs matches in the title and section path higher than in the body.

    Ranking & answers

    Synonyms & stop words

    TurboQuant v2

    Chunk vectors are stored as 4-bit codes after a seeded Hadamard rotation, with a scale/offset per 32 dimensions (f16). Search multiplies the f32 query with the 4-bit codes directly (SIMD), nothing is decoded. Vectors of the desktop app (TurboQuant v1) remain readable.
